question:
Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.

Twice a month
solution:
The correct answer is "**Bimonthly".**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The most appropriate meaning of the given group of words is **'Bimonthly'**
 
• **Bimonthly:** happening or appearing every two months or twice a month.
 
 
• **Example: ***The magazine is published **bimonthly**, with six issues a year.*
 
 
 
• Therefore, as per the above-mentioned points, we find that the correct answer is **option 1.​**

**​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• Let's look at the meaning of other words given in the options.

 
 

 **Words**
 **Meaning**
 **Example**

 happening once a month
 
 
Most of these people are paid **monthly.**

 
 
 

 **Biennial**

 The first of a series of **biennial** exhibitions.

 happening in the middle of a calendar year or a financial year.
 This is the** half-yearly** meeting of the interim committee.
